ce_bugs.text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90 — group.users.delete(id)` takes the has_many-:through `delete_all` path, so GroupUser callbacks never run and the `groups.user_count` counter cache is never decremented — spec:129 asserts `group.users.count` (a live COUNT), so this ships green forever.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90 — Rails' `CollectionProxy#delete` calls `find(records)` when given a Fixnum, so removing a user who is no longer a member raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` (404) instead of a no-op — trigger: two admins on the same group, or one admin retrying after a timeout, or a stale page-2 roster.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — Usernames are not stripped, so an admin who types `alice, bob` in the selector silently loses ` bob` and still gets `success_json`; spec:103 joins with a bare `,` so the suite never sees the whitespace path.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — Unknown usernames are dropped with no accumulation and the action returns `success_json` regardless — with N names where the 3rd is a typo, the admin sees success and a roster missing one person, with nothing to distinguish it from a full add.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:23 — params[:offset].to_i` is unclamped on a publicly reachable endpoint: `GET /groups/staff/members.json?offset=-1` emits `OFFSET -1`, which PostgreSQL rejects, producing an unhandled 500.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — limit` is unclamped: `?limit=-1` gives `LIMIT -1` (PG error, 500) and `?limit=1000000` serializes an entire group's users through `GroupUserSerializer` in one anonymous request.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:67 — params.require(:usernames)` runs before the automatic-group guard and assumes a String — an authorized admin posting `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b` hits `Array#split` and gets a NoMethodError 500; a blank `usernames` gets 400 instead of the intended 422.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:25 — The member refresh URL keys off `this.get('name')`, which is two-way bound to the unsaved Name text field — edit the name, then page or remove a member, and the refresh hits `/groups/<unsaved-name>/members.json` and 403s, so the roster silently stops updating.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js:13 — offset` is never reset on route entry and the model is the long-lived object held in the `adminGroups` array, so leaving a group at page 3 and re-entering it reloads page 3 — past the end if members were removed meanwhile.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:21 — The member list and its per-member remove X render for automatic groups — only the "add members" block at :25 is `{{#unless automatic}}`-guarded — and the guard is delegated to group_member.hbs where `automatic` is resolved in the item view's scope rather than the group's.
app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:26 — Non-automatic groups were previously never paginated, so every existing caller of GET /groups/:name/members now silently gets only the first 50 members.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:34 — The incremental `PATCH /admin/groups/:id` `changes:{add,delete}` API is deleted, but `resources :groups` still routes PATCH to `update`, so legacy clients get 200 OK while their membership edits are silently discarded.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:38 — update` unconditionally assigns `visible = params[:visible] == "true"`, so legacy PATCH/partial-update callers that omit `visible` now silently flip the group to hidden.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:25 — create` ignores `alias_level` even though `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends it and `update` honors it, so the alias level chosen for a new group in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:43 is dropped.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — add_members` assumes `usernames` is a comma-joined String and calls `.split`, raising NoMethodError (500) for clients sending the `usernames[]` array form.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, so any group whose size is an exact multiple of limit (50 members at the default limit of 50) gets a phantom trailing page that renders empty.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The new default limit of 50 now applies to non-automatic groups, which previously returned their full roster, and group/members.hbs has no pager, so public group pages silently truncate at 50 members.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:45 — addMembers/removeMember attach no rejection handler and both callers discard the returned promise, so a 422 (automatic group) or network failure leaves the UI unchanged with no error surfaced.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:23 — offset is never reset after a removal, so deleting the last member on the last page re-requests an offset equal to the new total and strands the admin on an empty page.
app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — usernames.split(",") does not strip whitespace, so "alice, bob" silently drops " bob" because find_by_username misses on the leading space.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:67 — params.require(:usernames) runs before the automatic-group guard, returning 400 instead of the intended 422; an array-valued usernames param hits Array#split and 500s.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:23 — offset is not clamped to >= 0, so offset=-1 emits OFFSET -1 and an unhandled PG error, and a non-numeric limit silently becomes LIMIT 0 (looks like an empty group).
app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:38 — update unconditionally sets visible = (params[:visible] == "true"), so a partial update that omits :visible silently un-publishes the group.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:22 — create never reads params[:alias_level] even though asJSON sends it and the form renders the alias-level combo for new groups, so the chosen value is dropped while the client model keeps showing it.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:30 — Concurrent findMembers calls (rapid next/previous, or a removal racing a page change) can resolve out of order and overwrite members/offset/user_count with a stale response.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:21 — findMembers now returns undefined for an unnamed group but a promise otherwise (it previously always returned a promise), so callers cannot chain it reliably.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:6 — Public members list now reads the paginated `members` property but ships no pager, so pagination controls exist only on the admin screen while both consumers share the same paginated model.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:1 — The `{{#if model}}` guard is now always true because model is the Group rather than the member array, leaving a dead and misleading condition.
spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — remove_member test issues `xhr :put` while the route and the sibling test at line 125 use DELETE.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — User-controlled `limit` has no upper clamp on this anonymous-accessible endpoint, so `?limit=10000000` against an automatic group (e.g. trust_level_0 = every user) fetches and serializes the entire membership in one request.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — The comma-separated `usernames` list is iterated with no cap on its length, so one request can tie up a worker for an unbounded number of sequential lookups and per-user inserts.
